title: Mock exam in the style of ZIMSEC A-Level Chemistry Paper 1
description: A practice paper modelled on ZIMSEC A-Level Chemistry Paper 1: 40 multiple-choice questions, 40 marks, 1 hour. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **all** 40 questions. You have 1 hour.

- Each question is worth 1 mark. Choose the one best answer.

Check the instructions on your own examination papers.

title: Mock exam in the style of ZIMSEC A-Level Chemistry Paper 2
description: A practice paper modelled on ZIMSEC A-Level Chemistry Paper 2: six compulsory 10-mark structured questions, 60 marks, 1 hour 30 minutes. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **all** the questions. You have 1 hour 30 minutes. A calculator may be used.

- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

Question sizes and part splits are our convention; real papers vary. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.

title: Mock exam in the style of ZIMSEC A-Level Chemistry Paper 3
description: A practice paper in the style of ZIMSEC A-Level Chemistry Paper 3: six 15-mark free-response questions chosen from ten (physical, inorganic, organic and applied chemistry), 90 marks, 2 hours 30 minutes. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **six** questions: at least two from Section A (physical), one from Section B (inorganic), two from Section C (organic) and one from Section D (applied). You have 2 hours 30 minutes. If you answer more than six, your best six count.

- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

Question sizes and part splits are our convention; real papers vary. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.

title: Mock exam in the style of ZIMSEC A-Level Chemistry Paper 4 (written practical skills)

It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **all** the questions. You have 2 hours 30 minutes. Describe in words what you would observe and record.
